plants.title: Blackwell
plants.dek: GB300 NVL72: 72 Blackwell Ultra GPUs, 36 Grace CPUs, 20 TB of GPU memory, 130 TB/s NVLink, and 1,440 PFLOPS FP4 with sparsity.
plants.label: GPUs · GB300 NVL72
plants.imageAlt: NVIDIA Blackwell GPU package render: the compute silicon in the center with four memory stacks above and four below, inside a gold frame.

plants.title: Rubin
plants.dek: 50 PFLOPS of NVFP4 inference and 288 GB of HBM4 on the Rubin GPU. Vera Rubin NVL72 is 72 Rubin GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs.
plants.label: NVFP4 inference · Rubin GPU
plants.imageAlt: NVIDIA Rubin GPU package render: the compute silicon in the center with four memory stacks above and four below, inside a silver frame on a black background.

plants.title: Meta and Nvidia
plants.dek: Millions of Blackwell and Rubin GPUs for Meta, including GB300 systems, plus Grace CPUs.
plants.label: Blackwell and Rubin GPUs

plants.title: MTIA
plants.dek: 300, 400, 450, and 500. The 300 is in production with 216 GB HBM3E. The 400 is a 72-accelerator rack. Compute FLOPS from the 300 to the 500 is 25x.
plants.label: HBM3E · MTIA 300
plants.imageAlt: Meta MTIA chip package: blue-tinted silicon and memory stacks inside a blue frame, on a black background.

plants.title: Meta and Broadcom
plants.dek: Custom accelerators for Meta's MTIA program through 2029. The first phase is more than 1 gigawatt.
plants.label: First phase · through 2029

plants.title: Instinct
plants.dek: Custom MI450 GPU for Meta's first gigawatt, with Helios racks. MI300 and MI350 are the series Meta already runs.
plants.label: Custom Instinct GPU
plants.imageAlt: AMD Instinct MI350-series accelerator module: a black board with the AMD logo, memory around a silver frame, and a blue, green, and orange compute die, on a black background.

plants.title: Ironwood
plants.dek: Google's seventh-generation TPU, with Trillium (TPU v6e) as the generation before. $12 per chip-hour on demand in us-central1, $5.40 on a three-year commitment.
plants.label: On demand per chip-hour · us-central1
plants.imageAlt: Google Ironwood TPU: a metal-framed chip with amber silicon and the word Ironwood printed on the frame, on a black background.

plants.title: Meta and AMD
plants.dek: Up to 6 gigawatts of Instinct GPUs. The first gigawatt is a custom MI450, with Helios racks. Meta already runs MI300 and MI350.
plants.label: Up to · Instinct GPUs

plants.title: Trainium2
plants.dek: Annapurna Labs chip for AWS. 96 GiB of HBM per chip, 64 chips to a Trn2 UltraServer. Project Rainier runs nearly 500,000 of them for Anthropic.
plants.label: Dense FP8 · per chip · AWS
plants.imageAlt: AWS Trainium2 chip package: two silicon compute dies, each flanked by memory stacks, inside a silver frame stamped with the Annapurna Labs logo, on a black background.

plants.title: Maia 200
plants.dek: Microsoft's inference chip. TSMC 3nm, 216 GB of HBM3e at 7 TB/s, 750 W. Deployed near Des Moines, Iowa.
plants.label: FP4 · per chip · Microsoft
plants.imageAlt: Microsoft Maia 200 chip: a silver-framed package with Microsoft Azure Maia 200 printed on the silicon lid.

plants.title: WSE-3
plants.dek: One chip the size of a silicon wafer: 4 trillion transistors and 44 GB of on-chip SRAM. 125 PFLOPS peak AI on the WSE-3, 250 on the WSE-3 Turbo.
plants.label: AI cores · one wafer · Cerebras
plants.imageAlt: Cerebras WSE-3 Turbo wafer, a single dinner-plate-size chip

plants.title: Ascend 910C
plants.dek: Huawei's current AI chip. Up to 384 in one Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD, rated up to 307.2 PFLOPS of FP16, with 128 GB of memory per chip.
plants.label: Chips · Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD

plants.title: Colossus fabric
plants.dek: Per-server network on the Colossus campus.
plants.label: Company · fetched 13 Sep 2026

plants.title: Prometheus
plants.dek: New Albany, Ohio. Over 1 gigawatt and tens of thousands of graphics chips once complete.
plants.label: Once complete

plants.title: Eagle Mountain
plants.dek: Utah. Raised to more than $3 billion on 14 September 2026.
plants.label: 14 Sep 2026
